I am an Assistant Professor in Finance at Copenhagen Business School.

My primary research interests are household finance and behavioral finance. I received my Ph.D. in Finance from the University of Chicago, Booth School of Business, and an Honors BSc in Economics and Mathematics from the University of Toronto.

You can download my CV [here](cv.pdf). Feel free to reach me at <chc.fi@cbs.dk>.
